audiobookrequest.description: Request portal for audiobooks. Approved requests are searched and imported through Chaptarr.

audiobookshelf.description: Audiobook library and player with progress sync. Reads the audiobooks Chaptarr imports.

bazarr.description: Subtitle manager for Sonarr and Radarr libraries.

chaptarr.description: Readarr-style book manager (beta). Searches through Prowlarr, downloads with qBittorrent, imports audiobooks for Audiobookshelf and hardlinks ebooks into the CWA ingest folder.

cloudflared.description: Tunnel client exposing selected apps publicly.

comida.description: Comida di Buteco tracker. Own app; follows new image builds automatically.

configarr.description: Syncs quality profiles and custom formats into Sonarr and Radarr on a schedule.

couchdb.description: CouchDB backing the Obsidian live-sync vault.

cwa.description: Calibre-Web Automated: ebook library with OPDS and KOReader sync. Imports whatever lands in its ingest folder.

flaresolverr.description: Cloudflare-challenge solver proxy used by Prowlarr.

jellyfin.description: Media server for movies and shows with GPU transcoding.

kafka.description: Single-broker Apache Kafka with a Kafka UI for browsing topics.

mapa.description: Nosso Mapa: shared map app, frontend plus backend. Own app; follows new image builds.

muad-dib.description: muad_dib. Own app; follows new image builds automatically.

overseerr.description: Seerr request portal: household asks for movies and shows here.

plex.description: Media server for movies and shows.

prowlarr.description: Indexer manager feeding Sonarr and Radarr.

qbittorrent.description: Torrent client. Shares the data pool with the arr apps for hardlinked imports.

samsa.description: samsa. Own app; follows new image builds automatically.

sonarr.description: TV series collection manager. Hardlinks imports from qBittorrent.

wiki.description: This wiki. nginx serves docs/wiki straight from the repo; git-sync pulls main every minute. LAN only.
